title: Rav Shmuel bar Achitai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Gittin 39b: Rav Shmuel bar Achitai reports Rav Hamnuna the Elder, who reports Rabbi Yitzchak bar Ashyan, who reports Rav Huna, etc.
And in Sukkah 42a the reading is Rav Shmuel bar Chatai, but Dikdukei Soferim cites from a manuscript that it should read Achitai, and so it is cited in a manuscript in Keritot 12b.

notes.text: The complete Gittin 39b paragraph explicitly names Rav Huna after Yitzchak bar Ashyan. Hyman’s quotation ends before the following Hamnuna report, and that ending remains etc. The manuscript readings Achitai and Chatai are retained.
